label: TP
reason: User-supplied header names flow directly into the file path construction without any validation against allowed prefixes or suffixes. The code uses ESAPI.encodeForHTML which encodes HTML entities but does not sanitize filesystem path separators (/) or prevent directory traversal attacks. An attacker can supply a header named '../etc/passwd' to access arbitrary files, constituting a genuine Path Traversal vulnerability.

evidence.note: Header name extracted via getHeaderNames() and used unvalidated as filename component in File constructor, allowing path traversal.
